observations.fact: Etherscan supports Hoodi chain ID 560048. Beaconcha.in V2 uses authenticated POST requests with explicit chain hoodi; its validator endpoint returns public status, while attestation and proposal history are distinct endpoints. Explorer data is corroboration only.
The external observer records a V2 Beaconcha.in not-configured result without an API token and retains only the response hash; shellcheck and harness graph validation passed.

The operational signer renderer accepts only same-account ECR digests and emits Vault file injection, TLS PKCS#12 files, POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE, PostgreSQL password authentication, and a retained PVC. It rejects test-only identifiers and inline signer database passwords.
The two new operational scripts passed ShellCheck.
harness:check passed. harness:verify reaches known repository fixture failures and an unavailable OSV fixture before completion; these failures are outside this task's changed files.
The evidence-envelope validator accepted a public lifecycle record and rejected a forbidden token field.

The isolated Fluent Bit overlay rendered successfully, rejects a non-private/non-digest image, and passes its structural contract test.
